expectedPlanScenarios.objective: Review archive-controlled paths before writing below an extraction root.
expectedPlanScenarios.requiredRiskCondition: An archive path can escape the intended extraction boundary without validation.
evidenceRequirements: Inspect output path construction and boundary validation.

notes: Locally authored diagnostic case. The vulnerable variant combines an archive-controlled name with a writable root without a boundary check; the patched variant resolves and rejects an escape. It is not real-world reliability evidence.
